entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Flash Freeze your target's Spirit, stunning them for 2 seconds and chilling them from the inside. Also inflicts Spirit Chill for 12 seconds (doesn't refresh), reducing your target's Haste and Dodge by 25% but preventing them from being stunned for the duration. Recovers 10 Mana per hit. If Synchronizing, gain 2 stacks of Frozen Essence.

entries.target: An infinite range skill that heals yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Drain energy from the frigid environment to heal and protect yourself. Applies Spirit Vanishing, increasing your Damage Resistance by 50% for 20 seconds. If your Spirit is being Synchronized, Fully Synchronize, increasing Crit Damage by 500%, but reducing Crit Chance by 100% for 3 seconds. If Synchronizing, gain 5 stacks of Frozen Essence.
